_comment: Written by the trading runs. impliedMove is a decimal or null. null means the straddle was not pulled - an open checklist item, not a placeholder to guess at. This file is a list of what is AHEAD: the pre-close run prunes catalysts once their date has passed and re-reads spot from a live quote, because a reference price carried from the day it was written makes every implied range wrong.
prunedNote: RE-VERIFIED BY THE PRE-CLOSE AND CORRECTLY STILL EMPTY - a check that was run, not a file that was skipped. The earnings calendar was re-pulled LIVE across 2026-08-14 to 2026-08-20 and NOT ONE of the twelve watched names appears anywhere in it - not OKLO, UPST, SMCI, AMD, IONQ, RGTI, QBTS, LEU, SOUN, MARA, SMR or JOBY. So there is nothing whose date has passed and nothing whose spot could be stale, and the two duties this slot owes this file - remove catalysts whose date has passed, and refresh the reference price on every entry that remains - are both discharged by an empty list. The check is recorded because a file empty from neglect and a file empty from verification look identical from outside, and only one is worth trusting on Monday. WHAT CHANGED SINCE THE 8/13 PRUNE: the consequence that note carried forward has now been discharged. It recorded the OKLO position being held overnight into a window with no dated catalyst in it, which is why no straddle was owed; today that position is being SOLD on its time stop and the book goes flat into the weekend. So the board carries no overnight risk at all into Monday - not a hold against an empty calendar, but no hold. THE EMPTY FILE IS THE HONEST STATE: this board has no anticipated move ahead of it, and rows would only be kept populated here to look busy.
